title: Merlinpit25
description: This is for the Moshpit 2025 server to feel better allaround.
body:
This modpack setups up your Vanilla experience on the Mospit 25 winter server.

Use this on the Moshpit server to have a lot of Visual and Quality of Life upgrades.
If there are any problems just ask the owner Merlin for further informations.
